notes_sections.heading: Inventory audit
items: Pages 1–18 contained 509 unique postings; later page URLs returned no additional structured cards.
Sixteen plausible titles were opened from full JSON-LD descriptions. Obvious business, project, QA and application roles were counted but not opened.
The new October 6 Platform Engineer is Vancouver hybrid four days and ineligible.
No CAPTCHA or access restriction appeared.

method: The full Randstad Technologies inventory was fetched sequentially with pacing. Plausible DevOps, SRE, platform, cloud, infrastructure and observability postings were validated from full structured descriptions. One eligible role was auto-filed and one prior application preserved.
